name: North Dakota

notes: Food for home consumption is exempt.
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: Some North Dakota cities cap their tax on a single large purchase (for example the first $2,500 or so); caps are not modeled, which matters little for everyday store sales.

1 towns or townships that are county subdivisions, not Census places, are listed under "cousubs" (10-digit county subdivision GEOIDs); tracts in them can be matched with the LODES crosswalk column ctycsub. Most carry only the county rate.
